basics.name: Vaibhav Jain
basics.about: Product Engineer and IT Consultant experienced in startup and freelance ecosystems. I develop software and produce solutions, and apply machine learning concepts to projects for smarter outcomes.

responsibilities: Build micro-applications based on client requirements using JavaScript, React, MongoDB, and AWS.
Translate client needs into practical, reliable software solutions.
Engineered content-driven websites using Astro and Nuxt with Island Architecture, achieving 40% faster page load times and improved Core Web Vitals scores.
Executed Payload CMS integration with Node.js, cutting client content update time by 60% while maintaining full Vue/Nuxt frontend performance.
Assisted the team with setting up machine learning pipelines.
Guided and mentored interns on working effectively with ML models.
Handled technical communication, project planning, and client presentations.
Maintained and optimized the company website, decreasing page load time by 30% and ensuring 99% uptime.
Analyzed user behavior and delivered UX recommendations that improved site engagement by 20% across key conversion funnels.
